entities.name: The Coiled One
entities.description: Powerful ancient snake god of venom and vengeance from Innistrad, associated with dark magic.

entities.name: Leinore
entities.description: Sister who fought to free Sinnia from the mask.

entities.name: Sinnia
entities.description: Leinore's sister, who took a snake mask and fell under its control.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: Witch who confronted Leinore and fought Saryth.

entities.name: Saryth
entities.description: Entity using the townsfolk to feed the Coiled One via the mask.

entities.name: Snake mask
entities.description: Mask adorned with snake features, a conduit for Saryth that controlled Sinnia.

entities.name: Harvesttide festival
entities.description: Festival during which the strange events unfolded.

events.summary: Leinore and Sinnia find a charred snake and later a snake-adorned mask, which Sinnia takes.
Wearing the mask, Sinnia gains power over the townsfolk and performs disturbing miracles while people go missing.
events.quote: People began to go missing, and Sinnia's behavior changed drastically.

events.summary: Leinore follows Sinnia and sees her feeding an unconscious man to a giant glowing egg.
events.quote: feeding an unconscious man to a giant, glowing egg in a forest clearing

events.summary: Katilda explains that the mask controls Sinnia as a conduit for Saryth, who feeds the townsfolk to the Coiled One.
events.quote: Saryth had been using the townsfolk to feed the Coiled One

events.summary: The Coiled One emerges from a chasm as Katilda and Saryth battle.
events.quote: Katilda and Saryth battled, causing further destruction.

events.summary: Leinore removes the mask, freeing Sinnia just as the Coiled One prepares to devour them.
events.quote: Leinore managed to remove the mask, freeing Sinnia from its control

events.summary: Saryth and the Coiled One go into the earth; Leinore, Sinnia and Katilda return to the settlement.
events.quote: With the mask destroyed, and Saryth and the Coiled One gone into the earth

relations.quote: Leinore and her sister Sinnia discovered a charred snake
